overview.text: Heather Thomason is a TV/screenwriter and a member of the Writers Guild of America. She says she was a renter for 16 years, experienced a 50 percent rent hike and displacement, and later found stability in a rent-controlled unit. She says she volunteers on the Santa Monicans for Renters Rights tenants rights hotline. She says she would work to protect rent-controlled housing from demolition and state laws, strengthen enforcement against harassment, educate about buyout amounts, and connect renters facing eviction to assistance.
